question: この調査結果を要件・設計・計画の根拠として使ってよいか。
description: Reviews a research write-up before anything is derived from it. The subject arrives inside the generic `artifacts` bundle rather than a dedicated research kind, matching flows/research-review.flow.json. Freshness and source availability are deliberately absent from this evidence list: a built-in web search is a Non-goal of #2017, so those two questions leave the run through human-escalation as open questions instead of being declared answerable from evidence.
subject: artifacts

baseline.description: A research write-up is judged on its own claim-to-source correspondence, not against a previous one, so this Flow declares no compare-baseline step.

evidence.description: The write-up and whatever sources it carries are the subject. Without them there is nothing to judge, and the run stops with DETERMINISTIC_UNRUNNABLE.
Absent requirements remove the claim-versus-use cross-check; the write-up-internal review still runs and the degradation is recorded.
Absent design skips the design cross-check and records the reason.
Absent plan skips the plan cross-check and records the reason.
